header.title: Facility settings
header.description: Maintain the organization identity, operating window, financial identifiers, report documents, public homepage, and printing defaults used across RCMS.

status.title: Configuration status
status.savedHelp: The form matches the currently loaded facility configuration.
status.unsavedHelp: Review and save before leaving this page.

profile.title: Facility profile
profile.description: Identity and contact details used across administrative, patient-facing, reporting, billing, and printing documents.
profile.invoiceExampleHint: Illustrative formatting only; this is not the next invoice number.

fields.centerNameHint: Required organization name displayed throughout the system.
fields.logoUrlHint: Direct logo image URL used in printouts and public pages.
fields.contactPersonHint: Primary operational contact for this branch.
fields.otherDetailsHint: Accreditation, registration, floor, or branch-specific notes.
fields.invoicePrefixHint: Short prefix placed before generated invoice numbers.

homepage.title: Public homepage
homepage.description: Customize the public radiology center website shown before login. These fields are safe to publish.
homepage.publishHelp: When disabled, the public page still shows essential contact details and secure portal links.
homepage.announcementHint: Short top-line text above the hero title.
homepage.heroImageHint: Use a direct image path or URL. Leave the default scan montage for a ready-made visual.
homepage.servicesHint: One service per line. Format: Title | Description
homepage.statsHint: One stat per line. Format: Value | Label
homepage.highlightsHint: One short highlight per line. These appear under the hero CTA.
homepage.securityNote: Public homepage settings are shared with the unauthenticated website only; internal report, receipt, and billing settings stay protected.

hours.title: Operating hours
hours.description: Define the facility-wide scheduling window using whole hours in 24-hour time.
hours.hourHint: Enter a whole hour from 0 to 23.
hours.invalid: Opening and closing hours must be between 0 and 23.
hours.operationalNote: Appointment availability also considers configured resources, existing bookings, holidays retained in the settings record, and equipment downtime.

documents.title: Document and invoice settings
documents.description: Configure report headers, footers, and safe document text used by generated reports and billing documents.
documents.htmlHint: Maximum 500 characters. Stored exactly as entered.
documents.headerPlaceholder: Facility name, logo markup, or report heading...
documents.footerPlaceholder: Contact details, accreditation text, or disclaimer...
documents.emptyHeader: Report header content will appear here.
documents.emptyFooter: Report footer content will appear here.

printing.title: Printing preferences
printing.description: Customize sticker dimensions, receipt content, report branding, invoice terms, and print previews.
printing.showQr: Display QR code for portal login on receipts
printing.invoiceTermsPlaceholder: Terms of payment, refund policy, etc...

states.errorDescription: The current facility configuration could not be loaded. No settings can be edited until the connection is restored.
states.refreshError: The latest settings could not be refreshed
states.showingSaved: The last successfully loaded configuration remains visible.

messages.saveFailed: Facility settings could not be updated
